title.zh: Zama expands confidential Morpho lineup after first vault hits $40 million, launches private swaps on Ethereum
title.en: Zama expands confidential Morpho lineup after first vault hits $40 million, launches private swaps on Ethereum

current_state.zh: Zama expanded its confidential Morpho vault lineup to 12 existing Ethereum vaults plus four confidential-only products and launched private swaps on Ethereum after its first vault reached $40 million.
